profile.headline: GIS | Certified ScrumMaster | Project Management | Software Development
profile.summary: Entrepreneurial at heart with a keen focus on personal growth and learning/mastering new skills. I'm a firm believer in adding value and helping people without any expectation of return. I truly enjoy networking with professionals and place a huge emphasis on building relationships with those who share a growth and success mindset. So if you happened to come across my profile, feel free to connect and I'm sure we can find a way to help each other.

positions.title: GIS Software Developer
positions.description: Since starting at MBI I have been heavily involved in the development and deployment of our firms Broadband Initiatives. Some of my specific roles include: software development, broadband consulting, ARPA, CPF, and CARES Act funding. With my distinct expertise in GIS, Software Development, and Broadband internet deployment, my team and I help bring Broadband service to historically underserved or unserved areas across the country. I have been responsible for developing marketing website materials for these underserved communities and deploying custom websites for community outreach and education. I’ve also played a major role in supporting our in-house Broadband Infrastructure Tracking System (BITS) which aids clientele in the tracking of their state’s active broadband projects and their service and budget milestones.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · SQL · C# · Product Development · Mitigation · JavaScript · Scrum · GIS Applications · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: GIS Technician
positions.description:
I am responsible for working on several different GIS projects for our many corporate/municipal clients including but not limited to many PA/OH/WV-based gas companies, educational institutions, and local township/borough governments.

My essential functions are creating map exhibits for clientele, training municipal governments on use of ArcGIS Online apps I create, multiple field work opportunities, and training/supervision of newer employees/internal users on ArcGIS products utilized in applicable workplace functionality.

positions.title: Contractor Asset Specialist
positions.description: Since starting at Crown Castle, I have been tasked with editing, maintaining, and organizing Crown Castle assets in our proprietary GIS database.  My experiences include attribution updates, SQL analysis, fiber network design, vector feature creation and manipulation, and working in various different GIS and CAD software.

positions.title: GIS Mapping Intern
positions.description: My duties included GPS-ing, mapping, digitizing, correcting, and publishing maps of Borough-owned and maintained regulatory signs.

positions.title: Operations Intern
positions.description: I was responsible for organizing, creating, and processing floorplans/blue prints into a CAD program and small applications of ArcMap and ArcCatalog 10.3-10.5.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Energy Geotechnology (Environmental Compliance Track)    Minor in Safety Science

volunteerExperiences.description: I help to clean up the AWARE operated site which is affected by Acid Mine Drainage and communal dumping on the site.
